mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3.0% in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% in the prior month), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year), a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals a cooling housing market that reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below prior month value
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 6.0% yoy and RSAFS falls below prior month value, or the Rank IC for the interaction between CPI and RSAFS over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) accelerates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above prior month value
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS rises above prior month value, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic strength and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below prior month value
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO falls below prior month value, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
